entities.summary: Burebista, a notable figure in the history of Romania, associated with Dacians & Roman Dacia (700 BCE–106). Preceded by Dacian Kingdoms. Their legacy influenced Trajan's Dacian Wars (101–106 CE) — conquest and provincialization and Roman Dacia & Romanisation.
